import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
open Polynomial
#check_failure Roth.sum_natDegree_update_lt
#check @Polynomial.degree_sub_lt_left
#check @Polynomial.natDegree_lt_natDegree
#check @Finset.sum_lt_sum
#check @Finset.sum_update_of_mem
theorem cancellation_degree {K : Type*} [Field K] {p q : K[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hq : q ≠ 0) (hd : p.natDegree = q.natDegree)
    (hne : q - C (q.leadingCoeff / p.leadingCoeff) * p ≠ 0) :
    (q - C (q.leadingCoeff / p.leadingCoeff) * p).natDegree < q.natDegree := by
  have hlc : p.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hp
  have hdeg' : degree q = degree (C (q.leadingCoeff / p.leadingCoeff) * p) := by
    rw [degree_C_mul (div_ne_zero (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hq) hlc),
      degree_eq_natDegree hp, degree_eq_natDegree hq, hd]
  exact natDegree_lt_natDegree hne (degree_sub_lt_left hdeg' hq (by
    rw [leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hlc]))
theorem family_cancellation_degree {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {φ : ι → K[X]} {i j : ι} (hp : φ i ≠ 0) (hq : φ j ≠ 0)
    (hd : (φ i).natDegree = (φ j).natDegree)
    (hne : φ j - C ((φ j).leadingCoeff / (φ i).leadingCoeff) * φ i ≠ 0) :
    ∑ k, (Function.update φ j
      (φ j - C ((φ j).leadingCoeff / (φ i).leadingCoeff) * φ i) k).natDegree <
      ∑ k, (φ k).natDegree := by
  have hlt := cancellation_degree hp hq hd hne
  refine Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun k _ ↦ ?_) ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, by simpa⟩
  by_cases hk : k = j
  · simpa [hk] using hlt.le
  · simp [Function.update_of_ne hk]
#print axioms cancellation_degree
#print axioms family_cancellation_degree

@degree_sub_lt_left : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] {p q : R[X]},
  p.degree = q.degree → p ≠ 0 → p.leadingCoeff = q.leadingCoeff → (p - q).degree < p.degree

@natDegree_lt_natDegree : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] {p : R[X]}
  {q : S[X]}, p ≠ 0 → p.degree < q.degree → p.natDegree < q.natDegree

@Finset.sum_update_of_mem : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι]
  {s : Finset ι} {i : ι}, i ∈ s → ∀ (f : ι → M) (b : M), ∑ x ∈ s, Function.update f i b x = b + ∑ x ∈ s \ {i}, f x
